results.title: Council to revisit housing incentives bill
results.description: A bill that would require the city to regularly disclose financial and other incentives it provides to affordable housing developers and their projects is raising concerns by the administration over tracking and reporting mandates.

results.title: The questions voters should ask midterm candidates
results.description: As voters approach the midterm elections, each party is eager to make the choice seem simple. Democrats point to the cost of living and argue that Republicans have failed to deliver economic relief. Republicans emphasize immigration, public safety and cultural questions, arguing that Democrats have lost touch with the country’s values. results.title: Man who died in ICE custody was denied medicine, his daughter says
results.description: When Estefani Andrade spoke over video last Friday to her father, who was in an immigration detention center in Texas, he looked pale and unwell, she said. The next day, he was found unconscious in his cell, and she was later told he died. The post Man who died in ICE custody was denied medicine, his daughter says appeared first on West Hawaii Today.
